stories.title: Israel's far-right dreams of rebuilding Gaza settlements
stories.summary: President Trump's peace plan for Gaza has been rejected by far-right Israeli officials who want the land for Jewish settlements.

stories.title: Mothers in the U.S. use crowdfunding tactics to help families in war-torn Gaza
stories.summary: After connecting through social media, an informal network of moms started crowdfunding to help families in Gaza afford food and shelter.

stories.title: Tallulah Proulx is making history at the Winter Olympics
Ice climbers welcome winter, finally
stories.summary: Unusually warm weather in the Rocky Mountains has meant the Ouray Ice Park in Colorado has been bare rock. Now that freezing temperatures have returned, there's a rush to scale the ice.

stories.title: A researcher's effort to make edible cotton seeds
stories.summary: Edible cotton seeds could revolutionize the cotton industry. That's the goal of  one researcher who says the seeds would be an inexpensive protein source that could help feed millions of people.

stories.title: Students' push for change results in new Latino history exhibit in Chicago
stories.summary: A group of Latino high school students in Chicago didn't feel represented by a local museum. They successfully petitioned the museum, resulting in a new exhibit reflecting local Latino history.
